# Vortex Digi Labs (VDL)

> Elite Agentic AI Systems, Interactive 3D WebGL Digital Twins & Autonomous Workflow Studio.
> Specializing in multi-model private agent pipelines, browser-native 3D equipment simulators, rapid PWA prototyping, and enterprise AI enablement.

## Overview & Brand Identity
Vortex Digi Labs is an elite systems engineering consultancy operating from Randburg, South Africa, serving global clients. We bridge the gap between heavy enterprise operations, sovereign AI models, and browser-native spatial computing.

- **Visual Architecture**: Futuristic Minimalist Space (Obsidian Space `#090A0F`, Frosted Glassmorphism, Metallic Silver/Chrome, Glowing Crimson Red `#FF2E2E` and Cybernetic Blue `#00B6FF` Accents).
- **Interactive 3D Engine**: WebGL / Three.js Celestial Particle Globe & Equipment Digital Twins (60fps, Draco compressed under 1.4 MB).
- **Primary Focus**: Multi-Model Agentic Systems, Google AI Ecosystem Architecture, Interactive 3D WebGL Digital Twins, High-Velocity App Prototyping, Enterprise AI Enablement.
- **Engineering Philosophy**: Technical precision, zero-install accessibility, deterministic reliability, self-healing operational automation.

## Core Solutions Architecture (Four Strategic Pillars)

### Pillar 1: Interactive 3D & Digital Twin Pilots (SYSTEM // WEBGL-THREEJS)
- **Focus**: Browser-based equipment simulation, machinery visualizers, and technical curriculum transformation.
- **Key Deliverables**:
  - Legacy 2D-to-3D vector overhauls (converting technical schematics and PDF manuals into interactive spatial assets).
  - High-fidelity browser runtime rendering with target budgets under 1.4 MB (Draco mesh compression).
  - Zero-install interactive training modules supporting WebXR, 360° orbit inspection, exploded assemblies, and telemetry overlays.
- **Core Stack**: Three.js, WebGL 2.0, WebXR, Blender GLB optimization pipeline, CAD vector conversion, GLSL shaders.

### Pillar 2: Autonomous Workflows & Agentic Systems (ORCHESTRATION // MULTI-MODEL)
- **Focus**: Enterprise private RAG architectures, multi-model task orchestration, and background worker loops.
- **Key Deliverables**:
  - Self-healing task runners and continuous background verification loops with deterministic recovery.
  - Zero-hallucination private RAG grounded in enterprise standard operating procedures (SOPs), manuals, and databases.
  - Cost- and latency-aware routing across Google AI Studio, Gemini API, Claude, and local Ollama weights.
- **Core Stack**: Google AI Studio, Gemini API, NotebookLM, LangChain, PostgreSQL, Event Webhooks.

### Pillar 3: High-Velocity Application Prototyping (DEVELOPMENT // RAPID PROTOTYPE)
- **Focus**: Rapid-cadence development translating operational concepts into production-grade PWAs, internal dashboards, and Android-compatible tools.
- **Key Deliverables**:
  - Progressive Web Apps with offline ServiceWorker caching and instant edge execution.
  - Real-time transaction queues and automated WhatsApp order dispatching.
  - Production TypeScript architectures deployed with instant Vercel cloud edge scaling.
- **Core Stack**: React, Vite, Next.js, ServiceWorker PWA, Meta Cloud API, Vercel Edge.

### Pillar 4: Enterprise AI Enablement & Creative Upskilling (HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP // WORKSHOPS)
- **Focus**: Pragmatic enablement for executives, operators, and creative teams based on the Atlas syllabus.
- **Key Deliverables**:
  - Hands-on operational agent tooling tailored for non-technical personnel.
  - Team Canva design system configurations for brand-safe generation.
  - Script-to-screen programmatic video pipelines with neural voice cloning and dynamic visuals.
- **Core Stack**: Atlas Syllabus, Canva Enterprise, Neural Voice Models, ComfyUI, Evaluation Harnesses.

## Sector Deployments & Industrial Proof (Anonymised Case Studies)

### Sector 01: Heavy Agri-Industrial & Technical Education
- **Scope**: Industrial Curriculum Modernisation & Digital Twin Transformation.
- **Execution**: Overhaul of 20 legacy vocational training modules; legacy hand-drawn schematics converted into high-fidelity 2D/3D digital vectors; interactive WebGL grain milling machinery simulation suite deployed to production with 100% WCAG alt-text compliance.
- **Status**: PILOT DEPLOYED // CONTINUOUS ITERATION.

### Sector 02: Quick-Service Hospitality & Digital Commerce
- **Scope**: Omnichannel Menu PWA & Automated Order Routing.
- **Execution**: High-velocity Progressive Web App deployment with dynamic visual menus, high-conversion cart architecture, and automated WhatsApp order dispatching in under 650ms.
- **Status**: PRODUCTION ACTIVE.

### Sector 03: Automated Media & Creative Production Pipelines
- **Scope**: Script-to-Screen Short-Form Video Automation.
- **Execution**: Custom programmatic content pipelines integrating LLM scripting, neural voice generation, and automated motion graphics workflows, achieving 10x production velocity vs traditional studio shoots.
- **Status**: PIPELINE VERIFIED.

## Proprietary Media Pipeline (Script-to-Screen)
1. **Script & Strategy**: Structured prompt engineering ingesting operational specs for deterministic screenplay generation.
